en.detailIntroHtml: Extension that automatically cross-checks Trendyol flash-deal offers against a pre-defined floor-price list.

detailSections.textHtml: Verifying each flash-discount offer against a floor price manually across hundreds of products wasn't practical due to commission structure considerations.

en.detailIntroHtml: A desktop application that combines T-Soft CSV order data and marketplace Excel sales reports into analyzable reports by channel, SKU, and date.

detailSections.textHtml: T-Soft and marketplace sales data are exported in different formats. T-Soft may require multiple CSV files, while marketplace reports arrive as Excel files with a separate column structure. Analyzing these files separately and seeing total SKU sales with channel performance in one report required manual work.

The application accepts multiple T-Soft CSV files and one marketplace Excel file from the same screen, then converts them into a shared report structure. Marketplace sales are analyzed with sub-channel breakdowns, while T-Soft sales are handled through process filters and saveable templates. Total SKU summary, channel summary, date filtering, and Excel export are delivered in a single flow.

E-commerce sales data from different sources were unified in one application, greatly reducing the need for manual file comparison, pivot preparation, and report merging. Total SKU performance and marketplace/T-Soft channel distribution became visible in just a few clicks.

en.summaryHtml: A desktop app that converts Trendyol XLSX and Hepsiburada CSV order exports into the simplified Excel format needed by the warehouse team.
en.detailIntroHtml: A desktop application that converts Trendyol and Hepsiburada order exports into a clean, warehouse-ready Excel workbook.

detailSections.textHtml: Trendyol and Hepsiburada export their daily order lists in different formats. Trendyol includes an extra notice row and many unnecessary columns, while Hepsiburada arrives as CSV and sometimes provides seller stock codes as ENT-HB barcode values. Preparing the warehouse list required daily manual column cleanup, stock-code checks, and file merging.

The tool accepts the Trendyol XLSX file, the Hepsiburada CSV file, and a barcode-to-stock-code database workbook from one screen. It removes the unnecessary Trendyol row, keeps only the required columns, cleans the Hepsiburada output, converts ENT-HB barcode values into real stock codes through the database, and produces one Excel workbook with separate sheets for each marketplace.

The daily warehouse order-preparation workflow was reduced from repetitive manual Excel work to a single controlled action. Marketplace exports became standardized, barcode-to-SKU conversion was automated, and the final warehouse file became faster to prepare, easier to read, and less prone to human error.
